# get_fidx

`#!python get_fidx()`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Compute the flat index identifier string for generated code.

**Returns**

_str_
: `"idx_e"` for electrons; otherwise `"idx_<name>"` with
    `"+"` replaced by `"j"` and `"-"` replaced by `"k"`.
